# Anbennar Overhaul: racial traditions. Gives each culture its traditions at game start; the effect is generated by
# tools/build_racial_traditions.py. See docs/systems/racial-traditions.md.

on_game_start = {
	on_actions = { aov_racial_traditions_game_start }
}

aov_racial_traditions_game_start = {
	effect = {
		aov_racial_traditions_game_start_effect = yes
	}
}
